description: This file defines the ProposedOrder class used in manufacturing resource planning (MRP) within the OFBiz framework. It manages proposed order data, calculates start dates, quantities, and creates requirement records.

classes.name: ProposedOrder
classes.description: Represents a proposed manufacturing order, including methods for calculating start dates, quantities, and creating requirement records.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the proposed order.

methods.name: getRequirementStartDate
methods.description: Returns the calculated start date for the requirement.

methods.name: calculateStartDate
methods.description: Calculates and updates the start date for the proposed order based on routing, product type, and lead times.

methods.name: calculateQuantityToSupply
methods.description: Adjusts the order quantity based on reorder quantity and stock levels.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a requirement record in the system for this proposed order.

methods.name: setMrpName
methods.description: Sets the MRP name for the proposed order.
